pairs.registryProposal: engine-selection says a player timeline has no reduced form unless a second asset is exported. RemotionStage can seek to the last frame, so a frame-addressable player already has a reduced variant the technique does not name.

src/app/globals.css:691 The shared reveal inlines a millisecond duration and a raw cubic-bezier. It does not name a duration class or an easing role.

pairs.registryProposal: Reveal documents once:false as intentional for a full-viewport snap deck. unprompted-motion-lifecycle and one-shot-guarding treat every scroll-back as a re-read and give no chapter exception.
